name: browser-connector
description: Control an explicitly authorized local Chrome session through provider-agnostic MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Use your visible, signed-in Chrome from Codex
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to explicitly controlled Chrome tabs for semantic page reading, visible interaction, screenshots, console and network debugging, and approved file transfer. Browser authority and approvals remain local.
